points: Just describe the object — no images or model files needed first.
Choose realistic, cartoon or other styles to match your project.
Set face count and size, then refine materials and file formats.

Have the agent check progress, download results and organise files.

print.title: Turn photos and ideas into figurines, ornaments and custom pieces
print.intro: Convert images or text into detailed 3D models, export print files and make your own figurines, ornaments and custom objects.
points: Watertight by design, less hole-fixing: closed, manifold models cut slicing errors from holes and non-manifold edges and reduce pre-print repair.
Fine structures still print: thin walls, slim rods and local detail hold their shape and strength at the target size.
Standard print formats for mainstream slicers: export STL / 3MF and drop into your existing print workflow.

game.title: Generate characters, props and scenes to prototype games faster
game.intro: Turn concept art or text into textured 3D assets, skip modelling from scratch and validate gameplay and scenes sooner.
points: Controllable face count, detail and performance: tune geometry per asset so characters, props and set pieces fit your budget.
Full PBR materials, less manual setup: colour, roughness, metallic and normal channels for faithful materials in-engine.
Multi-format delivery for your tools: GLB / FBX / OBJ and more for editing, level building and prototyping.

film.title: Previs the scene and shots first, then generate AI video
film.intro: Use an agent with Blender to turn shot descriptions into grey-box reference video, giving AI video clear composition, space and motion.
points: One scene, many shots: lock characters, props and layout, then switch camera positions to previs different shots without rebuilding.
Real 3D cameras, controllable framing and moves: focal length, position and path previs dolly, pan and tracking before you generate.
Continuous grey-box video, clear action and timing: spatial relationships, character motion and shot timing as a coherent reference.
